reason: A document-processing plugin that provides bounded reading for spreadsheets, notebooks, PDFs, word-processing files, and presentations, plus writing for spreadsheets and notebooks through DSH, MCP, and CLI interfaces.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供对电子表格、Jupyter 笔记本、PDF、DOCX 和 PPTX 文件的受限读取，以及对 XLSX 和 IPYNB 文件的创建与编辑。
summaries.en: Provides agents with bounded reading for spreadsheets, Jupyter notebooks, PDFs, DOCX, and PPTX files, plus creation and editing for XLSX and IPYNB files.

capabilities: Reads bounded content from xlsx, ipynb, pdf, docx, and pptx files
Creates and edits xlsx and ipynb files
Exposes document operations through DSH tools, an MCP server, and a CLI
Monitors and supports approval conversations for DSH agents through a WeChat gateway
